exposure: Cesarean scar pregnancies with MVA treatment failure
Pregnancy localization (cesarean scar, ovarian, interstitial, rudimentary horn, abdominal, cervical)
outcome: Risk factors for non-tubal ectopic pregnancies
Treatment outcomes of non-tubal ectopic pregnancies
Predictive factors for MVA failure in CSP
cohort: 110 women with non-tubal ectopic pregnancies treated at a tertiary care center between 2014 and 2019
finding: The size of the ectopic pregnancy mass, gestational week, presence of fetal heartbeat, and history of pelvic inflammatory disease were predictive factors for the failure of manual vacuum aspiration in cesarean scar pregnancy cases.
gest_age: Mean gestational age varied between groups, with CSPs having a higher mean gestational week than other NTEPs (8.43 ± 1.16 weeks vs. 6.66 ± 1.49 weeks)
